comment: tty_yn_function()'s clean_up clears WIN_MESSAGE when the prompt wrapped (cw->cury nonzero); tty_clear_nhwindow() then runs docorner(1, cury + 1, 0), which repaints the map row the prompt's second line covered. Minetown (debug-mode level teleport menu) has walls on map row 0, the first screen row below the message line. Eating from a square with a long-named food ration stack on top of two apples asks first about the rations, a prompt that wraps; 'n' moves on to the apples' one-line prompt, which leaves the repaired walls visible. Independent seed, date and character.
